design_philosophy: A government-grade, high-performance command center. The design relies on deep obsidian backgrounds, piercing neon accents (Cyan/Amber) for critical data, and 'Optical Clarity' glassmorphism. It uses a highly dense, tactical 'Control Room' bento grid with zero wasted space, ensuring analytical clarity while feeling undeniably futuristic.

rules.headings: Never use Inter for headings. Keep letter-spacing tight.
rules.numbers: All KPIs, gauges, and coordinates MUST use the mono font (JetBrains Mono).
rules.labels: Overlines and tiny labels MUST be uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.1em]).

layout.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout.spacing_scale: Dense. Use gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboard widgets. padding should be p-4 or p-6 inside cards.
layout.sidebar: Collapsible sidebar (glassmorphism applied). When collapsed, only icons visible. When expanded, icons + text.
layout.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-12. Main Map spans col-span-8 row-span-2. KPIs span col-span-3. Side panels span col-span-4.

glassmorphism.usage: Use for Sidebar, Main Header, Tooltips, AI Chatbot modal, and sticky elements.

neumorphism.usage: Use for primary data cards and KPI widgets to give them a tactile, embedded hardware feel.

glow.usage: Apply exclusively to active map nodes, critical alerts, and primary prediction gauges.

animations.micro_interactions: Buttons and list items must have background color transitions and text color brightness changes on hover.

components.cards: Do not use standard white Shadcn cards. Override Card background to #0A0A0A, add the tactile neumorphic shadow, and a 1px white/5 border. Radius MUST be max 8px (rounded-md or rounded-lg).
components.buttons: Primary CTA: Solid Cyan (#00F0FF) with black text. Secondary CTA: Ghost button with Cyan text on hover, border-white/10. Destructive: #FF3B30 with red glow.
components.gauges: Use Recharts or custom SVG for circular probability gauges. The track should be dark grey, the fill should gradient from Cyan to Amber to Red based on threat level.
components.interactive_map: Core element. If possible, integrate react-map-gl (Mapbox) with dark-v11 style. If building visually, use the provided 3D map image with absolute positioned glowing marker dots and a glassmorphism floating overlay panel for region stats.
components.ai_chatbot: Floating glassmorphic window in bottom right. Messages from AI use JetBrains Mono for a terminal/analytical feel. Messages from user are standard Manrope.
components.live_news: Vertical feed on the right or bottom. Use provided police/night images. Add a 'live' pulsing red dot to the header.
components.kpis: Top row. Each KPI needs a label (mono, tiny, uppercase), a massive value (text-4xl, mono), and a trend indicator (+14% in green/red).

backgrounds.description: Abstract radar/topographic background. Use as a fixed, low-opacity (10-15%) background under the entire dashboard.

maps.description: 3D holographic city map. Use inside the main 'Crime Map' container if an interactive Mapbox/Leaflet isn't rendering. Wrap in overflow-hidden and apply a subtle zoom animation.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, gauges, inputs, and map regions MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="crime-map-container"' or 'data-testid="predict-button"').
